title: actor.deactivate — Response
description: Returns the canonical agent actor envelope for the session whose credential was deactivated. No credential material is returned by this verb.

actor.description: Canonical agent actor envelope for the deactivated session.

kind.description: Deactivation responses are only defined for agent sessions.

agent_runtime.description: Runtime identifier for the deactivated agent session.

parent_actor_id.description: Human actor responsible for the deactivated agent session.
